title: Pull Vinyl
description: Pull-to-refresh on a list of top songs, set on a card over a warm well. Pull the card down and you uncover a record sleeve underneath; the record rolls out of it as far as you pull. Let go past the line and it spins, crackling, while it loads, rolls back into its sleeve, and the sleeve springs into the cover of the new song as it slides in. The new songs come from A Hard Day's Night, starting with I'll Be Back.
intent: The pull-to-refresh gesture made physical: the record you uncover is the song that arrives, and every row, cover and sleeve moves into place rather than appearing.
